visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair tied back and wearing a grey collared shirt speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor setting. (2) Static graphics appear showing Japanese magazine rankings and awards for a Decorté foundation bottle. (3) The woman gestures with her hand while explaining the product's accolades. (4) A close-up view of a hand holding a sleek glass foundation bottle with a black cap labeled Decorté. (5) Liquid foundation is pumped onto the back of a hand and spread, showing a creamy, light-reflective texture. (6) The woman applies the foundation to her cheek using a flat makeup brush. (7) She uses a pink triangular powder puff to blend the foundation into her skin. (8) A split-screen comparison shows 'Before' and 'After' results on her face. (9) Close-up shots of her face emphasize a dewy, glowing skin texture as she touches her cheek. (10) The woman continues her presentation in the indoor studio, holding the product. (11) A brief outdoor shot inside a car shows the woman's face in natural daylight to demonstrate makeup longevity. (12) Back in the studio, she holds both the foundation and a pink setting spray bottle while concluding the video.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 是哪瓶粉底 這麼厲害?. (2) [Subtitle]: 同時獲得公信力極高的 毒舌雜誌LDK 還有日本@cosme的 粉底新秀賞第一名. [Variety]: No.1. (3) [Subtitle]: 今天來分享這瓶 在日本賣爆的 黛珂禪 光感恆潤粉底液. [Slogan]: DECORTE ZEN WEAR GLOW. (4) [Subtitle]: 它同時兼具薄透性跟延展性. (5) [Subtitle]: 那因為添加了豐富的美容成分 所以上起來很像在擦保養品. (6) [Subtitle]: 用手指啊美妝蛋或粉撲 輕拍開來妝感就很美 那個光澤. (7) [Subtitle]: 剛剛好的遮瑕度 就可以把你的膚色不均 跟眼周暗沈遮住. (8) [Subtitle]: 人家看到你會覺得 哇~你的皮膚狀態看起來 很棒的那種錯覺. (9) [Subtitle]: 市面上大多持妝粉底 不是偏霧就是妝感會比較明顯 但這瓶就是 上起來會保留 肌膚原本的質感 再加上新科技 輕薄成膜的特性. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以時間拉長 比較不容易浮粉乾燥. (11) [Subtitle]: 我覺得它是非常適合 偏乾肌的光澤持妝粉底 難怪在日本可以賣那麼好. (12) [Subtitle]: 那現在靠櫃試色 就會送粉底液體驗包 母親節檔期 買任一款底妝 還會再送 持妝噴霧的正貨一瓶哦. [Slogan]: DECORTE.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An Asian woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a grey button-down shirt, star-shaped earrings, and a ring.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with a friendly, energetic tone over a steady electronic pop BGM with a moderate tempo. A clear 'ding' sound effect highlights the mention of awards. (2) The narration continues at a consistent pace as she describes the product application, with the BGM providing a rhythmic pulse. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs during a scene shift. The vocal intensity remains moderate and professional. (4) For a few seconds, a faint low-frequency environmental hum is heard as the scene changes to a car, but the speech and BGM remain the primary acoustic layers. (5) The voice returns to a clean indoor acoustic environment as the speaker details promotional offers, ending with the BGM fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Ranking Evidence -> Product Showcase -> Application Tutorial -> Comparison Results -> Technical Value -> Lifestyle Check -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Decorté Zen Wear Glow foundation by validating it with industry awards, demonstrating its skin-like finish through application, and encouraging viewers to take advantage of Mother's Day sales.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal naming of the brand and product, detailed showcase of the product packaging, and a dedicated closing segment about promotional offers.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A professional beauty influencer video optimized for social media, combining product demos with credibility markers and clear purchasing incentives.
